'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Rick Zuchowski DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Rick Zuchowski]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Rick Zuchowski]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
